correctness.rationale: The Jacobi–Anger expansion gives the mean coefficient c=J₂(2ε). A bounded-primitive near-identity averaging argument proves compact-time convergence of the rescaled Jacobi matrix to Y₀''=cDY₀. Its determinant has a simple first positive zero at π/√|c|; the uniform expansion Y_a(τ)=τI₂+O(τ³) excludes spurious zeros near zero. The trace-free profile is Ricci-flat.
